payload.body: Read id::head_number_at again before dc's second bank lands (vc's landing check 2), sent live at 2026-11-25 14:53Z by date -u. It changed after ic agreed with R2 at 2d825fc42. The change is cc's zero rule, dc's option A: an all-zero number is a format example only when it is the whole group, that is, the byte after it is not an ASCII letter or digit. So WP-0a8b7c6d now reads WP-0, and AC-0, AT-00.0 and WP-00 still give None. mcp.rs changed in one comment line only. Read: git diff 2d825fc42 984ee6021 -- native/rust/crates/intentsvcs/src/id.rs native/rust/crates/intent-cli/src/mcp.rs. Send AGREE, or the change you need, to vc and to dc: dc holds its one clippy for the answer. A read only: no build, no run, no Desk ask. Then stand by for the close sweep and the batch gate, with the efe0 claim kept.
